payload.reason: The evidence indicates that fine-tuning on natural language inference datasets, specifically SNLI, improves the quality of embeddings, particularly for semantic similarity and entailment tasks.

claims.text: Fine-tuning on natural language inference datasets improves the quality of sentence embeddings, especially on semantic similarity tasks and entailment tasks.
The best model combines embeddings from the top and bottom layers of BERT fine-tuned on the SNLI dataset.
